title: Summer $$2023$$ Midterm
body:
Selected questions from the Summer $$2023$$ Midterm.
Q4: We collect $$n$$ observations $$(x_i, y_i)$$ (one scalar feature $$x_i$$, $$one$$ $$scalar$$ $$target$$ $$y_i$$ each) and model each $$y_i$$ with one scalar parameter $$	heta$$: $$
$$ $$\hat{y}_i=f_{	heta}(x_i)=	heta e**{\sqrt{|x_i|}}$$
Q5: Kippa obtains a dataset of players' stats with columns 'Dis' (total distance in yards, a float), 'League' (a string with only two values: La Liga or Premier League), and 'Goals' (average goals per match, a float). A subset of five players is shown below:
• Erling Haaland: Dis $$55.7$$, Premier League, Goals $$1.373626$$
• Harry Kane: Dis $$116.0$$, Premier League, Goals $$0.745614$$
• Robert Lewandowski: Dis $$122.6$$, La Liga, Goals $$0.945946$$
• Marcus Rashford: Dis $$148.4$$, Premier League, Goals $$0.552764$$
• Karim Benzema: Dis $$165.2$$, La Liga, Goals $$0.775862$$
